svg.text: Offline notebook pipeline trains the models; a Flask serving layer turns their outputs into an investigation platform.
① OFFLINE TRAINING PIPELINE · Jupyter notebooks 01 → 10
Velocity, fan-in / fan-out, cross-bank & currency-mismatch features
Graph features: degree, PageRank, community, mule & hub patterns
Sequence models over account histories (LSTM, multi-scale CNN-1D)
Risk Engine → LOW · MEDIUM · HIGH · CRITICAL (129,124 alerts)
② ARTIFACT STORE · files on disk, read live by the server
③ SERVING LAYER · Flask (python dashboard/new.py · gunicorn new:app)
④ PRESENTATION · single-page dashboard in the browser
new.html · new.js — compose & screen a payment
